bullets_en: A woman was killed and her husband and infant son injured in an attack in Manipur's Tamenglong.
Suspected militants opened fire around 4 a.m. at Tollen Kuki village near NH-37, police said.
The woman was killed at her residence; security forces rushed in and gave medical aid.
The Kaimai Village Authority condemned the attack and sought an impartial investigation.
bullets_ur: Manipur ke Tamenglong mein ek hamle mein ek khatoon halak; unke shohar aur chhota beta zakhmi.
Police ke mutabiq militants ne kareeb 4 baje Tollen Kuki gaon mein, NH-37 ke paas, firing ki.
Khatoon apne ghar par halak ho gayin; security forces ne mauke par pahunch kar medical madad di.
Kaimai Village Authority ne hamle ki muzammat ki aur ghair-janibdarana jaanch ki maang ki hai.
